reviewer: Cursor, Australia/Brisbane — Public Voice clocks pass
notice: General information, not legal advice. A 14-day ask in a letter is the person's deadline, not a statute. FOI/complaint clocks below are only what the named official page said on the review date. This product does not lodge.

jurisdictions.name: Australia
jurisdictions.foi_clock: Commonwealth FOI Act: agency decision ordinarily within 30 days of receiving the request (extensions exist). Checked via OAIC FOI pages 15 Nov 2026 — confirm on the live page before relying.

channels.title: 1 · Public office / agency (spotlight ask)
channels.when: Always first when you want an explanation on the record.

channels.title: 2 · FOI request (process / admin records)
channels.when: When you need the agency's own paper on a non-exempt admin process. Not for classified material.

channels.title: 3 · Ombudsman
channels.when: After the agency step failed or the clock ran with silence / redirect.

jurisdictions.name: New Zealand
jurisdictions.foi_clock: Use the Ombudsman's OIA guidance for timeframes. Do not invent a day count here.

channels.title: 2 · OIA request
channels.when: For official information the agency holds.

jurisdictions.name: United Kingdom
jurisdictions.foi_clock: ICO: public authorities usually have 20 working days. Confirm on the live ICO page.
jurisdictions.ombudsman_name: Parliamentary and Health Service Ombudsman (MP route for many cases)

channels.title: 2 · FOI request
channels.when: For recorded information the authority holds.

jurisdictions.name: United States
jurisdictions.foi_clock: Do not invent a single federal day count here. Use the agency's FOIA page and FOIA.gov.

channels.title: 2 · FOIA request
channels.when: Via FOIA.gov or the agency portal.

channels.title: 3 · OGIS / liaison
channels.when: Process help, not a substitute for the request.
